classification.difficultyReason: Set the other coordinate to zero for each intercept, then use the two points to sketch each line. Familiar linked algebra and graphing procedures are explicitly directed.

content.prompt: Sketch the graph and label the $x$- and $y$-intercepts for the following lines.

answer.worked:
At the $x$-intercept, $y=0$.
$$\begin{align*}2x-1&=0\\2x&=1\\x&=\frac12\end{align*}$$
At the $y$-intercept, $x=0$.
$$\begin{align*}y&=2(0)-1\\y&=-1\end{align*}$$
Draw the straight line through $(\frac12,0)$ and $(0,-1)$.
